sources.note: Supports the statue material, pose, clothing and three inscribed pillars; no construction year inferred.

text.en: This life-size bronze statue at Museo ni Jesse Robredo depicts the former Naga mayor sitting on the ground.
Robredo wears a plain shirt and shorts, reflecting the museum's portrayal of his simple, down-to-earth character.
Three pillars behind the statue bear the words “Matino, Mahusay, Matapat,” in a design by Jun Vicaldo.
